result.stdout:
Usage: yamca [workspace-path] [options]
       yamca board reinit [workspace-path] [--wipe]

Commands:
  board reinit          Restore the default column structure of the dev board.
                        Cards in non-default columns are moved to idea.
                        Pass --wipe to delete all cards instead.

Arguments:
  workspace-path        Directory to sandbox the agent to (default: current directory).

Options:
  -p, --port <n>        Listen on a specific port (default: 9001).
      --no-browser      Do not open the default browser on startup.
      --wipe            (board reinit) Delete all cards instead of moving to idea.
  -h, --help            Show this help and exit.
      --version         Print the tool version and exit.
